name: woltron
description: Your very good food-fetching dog — automate Wolt orders with presets, packs, schedules, triggers and LLM search.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,magenta "npm -w @woltron/server run dev" "npm -w @woltron/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @woltron/web run build && npm -w @woltron/server run build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm -w @woltron/desktop run dev
